responsibility: Implements gm2’s constant-type resolution pass for designator and aggregate constants. It rebuilds scope context for modules and procedures, constructs typed expression trees for constant leaves, unary/binary operations, conversions, designators, function-like constant forms, and attributes, tracks constructor nesting and expression stacks, resolves constant aliases and unresolved designator constants iteratively, and writes the discovered constant or constructor type information back into the symbol table, emitting diagnostics for constants whose type still cannot be determined.
same_name_distinction: This implementation module contains the actual pass-C constant-expression and type-resolution machinery behind PCSymBuild.def; unlike the .def file, it builds expression nodes, walks unresolved designator constants, and iteratively resolves their types.
